summary.name: Simple Comic
summary.one_liner: A free Mac comic book reader for CBZ and CBR files, with multi-page reading modes and a QuickLook plugin for Finder previews.
use_cases: Reading CBZ or CBR comic archives on a Mac
Previewing comic files in Finder without opening them
Browsing pages of a comic with thumbnails
Reading PDF and ebook files alongside comics
summary.what_it_does: Simple Comic is a comic book reader for CBZ and CBR files on macOS. It offers multi-page reading modes and a thumbnail browser for navigating pages. It supports both Right-to-Left and Left-to-Right reading orders, which suits manga. It includes a QuickLook plugin so comic files can be previewed in Finder with rich icons. The App Store listing also describes it as an ebook reader for PDF, CBZ and CBR formats with Live Text search, per the awesome-mac listing.
notable: Right-to-Left and Left-to-Right reading modes for manga
QuickLook plugin for CBR/CBZ previews in Finder
Open source, listed on the awesome-mac list
Developer collects no data, per App Store privacy label
caveats: Mac only; requires macOS 11.5 or later
Listing has too few ratings or reviews to show an overview
